Morgan: Postmortem follow-up: we need owners + concrete dates for rotation, audit backfill, and the recurring sweep. Keep replies short.
Devon: I'll rotate svc-ingest and svc-cache. ETA 2026-05-04.
Kim: I'll run the audit backfill for svc-auth and billing-adapter after migration access. ETA 2 days after access.
Sam (sec): Scan found 3 problematic tokens and 1 missing audit entry. See short excerpt: ["svc-ingest:oldkey", "ci-runner:legacy", "billing-adapter:stale-2024"] missing_audit=["billing-adapter:stale-2024"].
Priya: I'll add a token-health alert and a weekly digest to telemetry. Rule: validation_failure_rate >1.5% for 30m -> page. ETA 2026-05-08.
runbook-bot: Reminder: follow-up checkpoint scheduled 2026-05-11 15:00 UTC.
Morgan: Compact actions: 1) rotate svc-ingest + svc-cache - Devon - 2026-05-04; 2) audit backfill svc-auth & billing-adapter - Kim - 2026-05-06; 3) alert + weekly digest - Priya - 2026-05-08; 4) kill-switch snippet in runbook - Sam - 2026-05-03. Please ack.
Devon: Ack. I'll open PR with dry-run steps.
Kim: Ack, will request RBAC from @Sam (sec).
Sam (sec): Ack. I'll post a minimal kill-switch snippet and test on staging.
Morgan: Noting recurring pattern: stale service tokens twice in 6 months. Proposal: quarterly sweep + permanent owner per service. Suggest first sweep 2026-06-01.
Priya: I'll add SLO: token_validation_success >=98% over 24h and include it in the weekly digest.
Morgan: Thx. Paste PR + runbook links into the postmortem doc when done or ping me.
